blurb: Camp on the Kentucky is the place where you "come as strangers and leave as friends." We are located in the community of Nonesuch in beautiful Woodford County, Kentucky. We are a quaint hideaway nestled on the historical palisades of the Kentucky River. If peace and quiet are what you're looking for, come camp with us!
